definitions.gloss: Atami; the seaside hot-spring resort town
definitions.explanation: A hot-spring town on the coast of Shizuoka Prefecture, less than an hour from Tokyo by Shinkansen. It was the archetypal destination for company trips and honeymoons during the postwar boom, and its name still evokes that era of resort tourism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熱海|あたみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to Atami this weekend.

examples.japanese: {熱海|あたみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked a hot-spring inn in Atami.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寂|さび}れていた→寂れる：12291_sabireru⟧{熱海|あたみ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: Atami, which had declined for a time, has recovered its energy as young tourists have come back.

notes:
The name is written with ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧ (hot) and ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) — hot springs once bubbled up in the shore itself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {熱海|あたみ}⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧: the Atami hot springs
- {熱海|あたみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花火大会|はなびたいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧: Atami's fireworks displays, held many times a year
- {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{熱海|あたみ}: "Atami for the company trip" — a stock image of Showa-era corporate life

CULTURAL NOTE:
Atami's decline in the 1990s and its revival as a weekend destination are a familiar case study in Japanese discussions of regional tourism. It is also the setting of the classic melodrama {金色夜叉|こんじきやしゃ}, whose seaside scene is marked by a statue on the beach.
